Applicant :- Mohit Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
List revised.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as the learned AGA for the State and perused the material placed on record.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant, Mohit, with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 274 of 2021(S.T. No. 540 of 2021), under Sections 498A,
323,504,328,304B IPC and section 3/4 D.P. Act Police Station Simbhaoli, District- Hapur, during pendency of trial.

entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
Mohit vs State Of U.P. on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16573150/
1
There is allegation against the applicant of causing dowry death of his wife
.The marriage of the couple took place three years ago.
Learned AGA has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant.
This Court after hearing the learned counsels for the parties does not finds any ground for enlarging the applicant on bail at this stage.
The bail application is accordingly rejected.

The court below is directed to conclude the trial against the applicant, as expeditiously as possible,
preferably within a period of six months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
